content:
Use the attached THE FIREFIGHTER storyboard as exact visual reference. Create a 12-second 16:9 Pixar 3D animated sequence following all 8 shots exactly. Same young male firefighter — strong jaw, warm brave expression, full yellow and black firefighter gear, red helmet with number 24 — bright suburban street, vivid red fire truck, bright blue sky and sunshine throughout. High energy, fast paced, emotionally powerful.
Shot sequence:
1. Wide shot inside the fire station. Firefighter sitting relaxed — alarm suddenly blares, red lights flash on the ceiling. He explodes to his feet instantly, pure energy. Red fire truck visible behind him in the bay. The station coming alive around him.
2. Close-up dramatic. Firefighter suiting up fast — yellow jacket snapped closed, red helmet pulled down and locked, boots stamped in. Every movement fast and precise. He raises one fist — ready. Seconds flat.
3. Wide dramatic. Massive red fire truck exploding out of the station doors — lights blazing red and white, chrome gleaming, bright blue sky above, green trees blurring past. Pure forward momentum. Unstoppable.
4. Overhead drone shot looking straight down. Fire truck racing through the suburban street from directly above — rooftops and green trees on both sides, vivid red truck a powerful streak cutting through below. Fast, urgent, every second counts.
5. Wide shot. Fire truck screeches to a stop in front of a house — orange flames and dark smoke from the upper windows, neighbours watching. Firefighter jumps off before it fully stops, moving toward the house immediately. No hesitation. Blue sky above.
6. Wide dramatic. Firefighter on the left bracing hard against the powerful hose — thick white water arc traveling all the way across the frame to the right where orange flames are visibly shrinking and retreating in real time. Steam exploding where water meets fire. Fire being defeated live.
7. Tight emotional close-up. Firefighter emerging through the front doorway carrying a child — child's arms wrapped tightly around his neck, firefighter's expression calm and protective. Smoke and orange glow behind him, bright blue sky and sunlight breaking in front. The human moment. Quiet after the chaos.
8. Wide warm shot. Fire completely out, smoke clearing upward, bright blue sky fully returned above the house. Firefighter removes his helmet slowly, looks up at the clear blue sky, one quiet deep breath of relief. Sun warm and golden. The street calm. Mission complete.
Camera: Wide inside station for the alarm, close-up dramatic for the suit up, wide dramatic for the truck exit, overhead drone for the speed, wide for the arrival, wide dramatic showing firefighter and dying flames for the hose, tight emotional close-up for the rescue, wide warm for the aftermath.
Style: Bright blue sky and sunshine throughout — nothing dark, nothing moody. Vivid red fire truck, orange flames, white water blast, yellow and black firefighter gear, green suburban trees. Pixar CGI vivid and high energy. Every shot bright and alive.
Sound: Fast urgent dramatic orchestral music — heroic and building, starts intense from frame one and never lets up until the final quiet moment. Continuous from first frame to last, no breaks. Natural sounds underneath — alarm blaring, gear snapping on, truck engine roaring, siren wailing, truck screaming through streets, flames crackling, hose blasting, steam explosion where water hits fire, child crying then quiet, helmet removed, one long slow exhale of relief. Music swells on the rescue and softens to warm resolution on the final aftermath shot.
Goal: 12 seconds. One alarm. One rescue. One clear sky. Fast, brave, and deeply moving to watch.

Bombero se quita el casco lentamente, mira hacia el cielo azul claro, una respiración profunda de alivio. Sol cálido y dorado. La calle tranquila. Misión completa.

---
添付の「THE FIREFIGHTER」ストーリーボードを正確なビジュアル参照として使用してください。8つのショットすべてに従って、12秒の16:9 Pixar 3Dアニメーションシーケンスを作成します。同じ若い男性消防士 — 力強い顎、温かく勇敢な表情、黄色と黒の消防士装備、番号24の赤いヘルメット — 明るい郊外の通り、鮮やかな赤の消防車、明るい青空と日差しが全体を通して。高エネルギー、速いペース、感情的に力強い。
ショットシーケンス：
1. 消防署内のワイドショット。消防士がリラックスして座っている — 突然アラームが鳴り響き、天井に赤いライトが点滅。彼は瞬時に立ち上がり、純粋なエネルギー。彼の背後に見える赤い消防車。消防署が活気づく。
2. クローズアップドラマティック。消防士が素早く装備を整える — 黄色のジャケットをパチンと閉じ、赤いヘルメットをかぶりロックし、ブーツを踏み込む。すべての動きが速く正確。彼は拳を上げる — 準備完了。数秒で。
3. ワイドドラマティック。巨大な赤い消防車がステーションのドアを爆発的に飛び出す — 赤と白のライトが輝き、クロームが輝き、明るい青空の上に、緑の木々がぼやけて過ぎ去る。純粋な前進の勢い。止められない。
4. 真上からのドローンショット。郊外の通りを真上から走る消防車 — 両側に屋根と緑の木々、鮮やかな赤のトラックが下を切り裂く強力なストリーク。速く、緊急、すべての秒が重要。
5. ワイドショット。消防車が家の前で急停止 — 上階の窓からオレンジの炎と黒い煙、近所の人々が見守る。消防士は完全に止まる前に飛び降り、すぐに家に向かう。ためらいなし。青空の下。
6. ワイドドラマティック。消防士が左側で強力なホースにしっかりと耐える — 厚い白い水の弧がフレーム全体を横切り、右側でオレンジの炎がリアルタイムで縮小し退却するのが見える。水が火に当たるところで蒸気が爆発。火がライブで打ち負かされる。
7. 感情的なクローズアップ。消防士が子供を抱えて玄関から出てくる — 子供の腕が彼の首にしっかりと巻きつき、消防士の表情は穏やかで保護的。彼の背後に煙とオレンジの輝き、前方に明るい青空と日差しが差し込む。人間の瞬間。混乱の後の静けさ。
8. ワイドウォームショット。火が完全に消え、煙が上昇し、明るい青空が家の上に完全に戻る。消防士はゆっくりとヘルメットを外し、澄んだ青空を見上げ、静かに深呼吸をする。太陽は暖かく黄金色。通りは静か。任務完了。

4. Plano aéreo de drone olhando diretamente para baixo. Caminhão de bombeiros correndo pela rua suburbana diretamente de cima — telhados e árvores verdes de ambos os lados, caminhão vermelho vivo como uma poderosa faixa cortando abaixo. Rápido, urgente, cada segundo conta.
5. Plano geral. Caminhão de bombeiros freia bruscamente em frente a uma casa — chamas laranja e fumaça escura das janelas superiores, vizinhos assistindo. Bombeiro salta antes que ele pare completamente, movendo-se imediatamente em direção à casa. Sem hesitação. Céu azul acima.
6. Plano geral dramático. Bombeiro à esquerda se firmando contra a poderosa mangueira — arco espesso de água branca viajando por toda a moldura até a direita, onde as chamas laranja estão visivelmente encolhendo e recuando em tempo real. 7. Close emocional apertado. Bombeiro emergindo pela porta da frente carregando uma criança — braços da criança firmemente enrolados em seu pescoço, expressão do bombeiro calma e protetora. 8. Plano geral quente. Fogo completamente apagado, fumaça se dissipando para cima, céu azul brilhante totalmente retornado acima da casa. Contínua do primeiro ao último quadro, sem pausas. Sons naturais por baixo — alarme soando, equipamento sendo colocado, motor do caminhão rugindo, sirene uivando, caminhão gritando pelas ruas, chamas crepitando, mangueira disparando, explosão de vapor onde a água atinge o fogo, criança chorando e depois em silêncio, capacete removido, uma longa e lenta expiração de alívio. Objetivo: 12 segundos. Um alarme. Um resgate. Um céu claro. Rápido, corajoso e profundamente comovente de assistir.
